# Perlego

> > Perlego is an online academic ebook subscription platform providing unlimited access to textbooks and scholarly resources across disciplines with Smart Search technology.

Perlego serves students and researchers with a digital library featuring books from major academic publishers like Wiley and Jossey-Bass. The platform offers study tools, research assistance, and access to textbooks spanning business, science, education, and technology.

## Key Topics

- Digital library subscription service
- Smart Search technology
- Academic textbooks and ebooks
- Student learning platform
- Research assistant tools
- Online learning resources
- Workplace management and leadership
- Thermodynamics and statistical mechanics
- Reinforcement learning and Python
- Industrial capitalism history
- Classroom management strategies
- Employee development and feedback
- Managing up techniques
- Cross-disciplinary academic content
- Publisher partnerships (Wiley, Jossey-Bass)

## Platform Overview

- [Perlego | An online subscription for all your academic books](https://www.perlego.com/): Homepage for Perlego's academic ebook subscription service with Smart Search

## Business & Management

- [[PDF] It's Okay to Manage Your Boss by Bruce Tulgan](https://www.perlego.com/book/1009310/its-okay-to-manage-your-boss-the-stepbystep-program-for-making-the-best-of-your-most-important-relationship-at-work-pdf): Bruce Tulgan's workplace management guide on managing up effectively
- [[PDF] Scale and Scope by Alfred D. Chandler Jr.](https://www.perlego.com/book/1133135/scale-and-scope-the-dynamics-of-industrial-capitalism-pdf): Pulitzer Prize winner Alfred D. Chandler Jr.'s study on industrial capitalism

## Education & Teaching

- [[PDF] Teaching Discipline & Self-Respect by SiriNam S. Khalsa](https://www.perlego.com/book/1004177/teaching-discipline-selfrespect-effective-strategies-anecdotes-and-lessons-for-successful-classroom-management-pdf): SiriNam S. Khalsa's classroom management strategies for positive discipline

## Science & Technology

- [[PDF] Thermodynamics and Statistical Mechanics by Robert J. Hardy](https://www.perlego.com/book/1000010/thermodynamics-and-statistical-mechanics-an-integrated-approach-pdf): Robert J. Hardy's graduate textbook on thermodynamics and statistical mechanics
- [[PDF] Reinforcement Learning Algorithms with Python by Andrea Lonza](https://www.perlego.com/book/1204150/reinforcement-learning-algorithms-with-python-learn-understand-and-develop-smart-algorithms-for-addressing-ai-challenges-pdf): Andrea Lonza's guide to reinforcement learning with Python and TensorFlow
